Context: Procurements without Calling Tenders

Purchase of goods without quotation.Purchase of goods up to the value oft 25,000 on each occasion, t 50,000 for common use goods and Rupees one lakh for scientific equipments and computers in case of Scientific Ministries / Departments can be made without inviting quotations or bids on the basis of a personal certificate to be recorded by the competent authority. Rule 154, GFR and Para. 4.9, Manual for Procurement of Goods.
